Cornell Tech Open House

What

Open House

When

Friday, Nov 13, 3:30 PM

Where

Tata Innovation Center, 11 E Loop Rd New York, NY 10044
Go To Site

Join the Cornell Tech community for an in-depth look at all of our Master’s Programs. During this event, you will have the opportunity to connect with admissions staff, faculty, and current students to learn more about:

  • The Cornell Tech campus
  • The House – on-campus housing unit
  • Graduate programs which include Master of Engineering, Dual MS, Tech MBA, and LLM
  • Our unique innovation-focused Studio curriculum Maker Day Sessions

 

ITINERARY:
2:00PM – Check-in opens
2:15PM – Campus & House Tours Begin*
3:30PM – Q & A with Admissions
4:00PM – Maker Day Presentations
4:30PM – Student Panel
5:00PM – Networking Session with Admissions Staff, Faculty & Students*

Itinerary is subject to change
* = optional

Please note that this is an in-person event with no online viewing option. If you are not able to attend this event in person, we encourage you to register for one of our virtual events.
